articles.title: oat-ai added to PyPI
articles.summary: On-demand Agent Tooling (OAT) marks a key advancement for Large Language Models (LLMs), allowing them to dynamically synthesize and create necessary tools on-the-fly. This innovation moves beyond relying on pre-defined toolsets, empowering LLMs to 'cook what they need' rather than just 'pick from a menu'. Such adaptability significantly enhances their problem-solving capabilities for complex tasks and real-world applications.

articles.title: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal in Maharashtra’s Thane district awards Rs 5 lakh compensation to family of tutor killed in motorcycle accident in 2003
articles.summary: The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT) in Thane district, Maharashtra, has awarded Rs 5 lakh compensation. This financial relief is directed to the family of a tutor who tragically died in a motorcycle accident. The tribunal's decision underscores the legal framework for supporting victims of motor vehicle accidents, providing some measure of justice to the bereaved family.
